question: Do current-main source and the complete immutable 256-row Dusk context provide exactly one identity-safe, death-disambiguated observation surface and enough policy, viability and card-pair support to justify one separately preregistered target-switch trace identity experiment?
hypothesis: Actual target switching between two single-target Attacks is an unobserved fight-local decision unit distinct from closed named-card, alternating-cadence, focused-to-sweep, Shatter and enemy-status families. Existing PLAY.targetIdx plus DIE.idx events are the smallest sufficient observation because targetIdx alone aliases a deliberate switch with a forced change after target death.

closedFamilyExclusions.namedCardSequencing: Scoreline, Afterimage, their timing controls and commitment fallbacks remain closed. Exact card IDs are breadth witnesses only.
closedFamilyExclusions.genericCadence: The closed cadence family alternates Attack and Skill over three plays. This audit requires two authored single-target Attacks and estimates no cadence payoff.
closedFamilyExclusions.focusedToSweep: The closed fanout family changes authored scope from enemy to allEnemies. Both target-switch cards have authored target=enemy; only their runtime enemy indices may differ.
closedFamilyExclusions.shatterAndFacet: No HIT, CHIP, SHATTER, Facet or damage event enters the predicate. The closed one-card cross-target Shatter family has a different event unit.
closedFamilyExclusions.enemyStatus: No Cracked, Dimmed, Weak, Smolder or other status enters the predicate, mediator or proposed payoff.
closedFamilyExclusions.otherClosedFamilies: Do not reconstruct Kindle, Ward, Ember-reserve damage, relic, one-bit setup, action-economy, weak-mend, same-instance repeat, acquisition scalar or private-debt paths.
closedFamilyExclusions.method: No ML, RL, optimiser, policy remap, grammar expansion or adaptive candidate tuning is permitted.

futureMechanismContract.researchIdentity: dusk-target-transfer; a research identity, not shipping copy.
futureMechanismContract.producer: After an exact Duskblade Attack with authored target=enemy resolves while combat remains live and its selected target remains alive, store that target index.
futureMechanismContract.mediatorState: One player-combat previous-target integer plus one paid Boolean for the current player turn; neither is a RunState or save field.
futureMechanismContract.consumer: The next exact Attack in the same player turn with authored target=enemy consumes the mediator only when it selects a different living enemy index after its unchanged authored effects and while combat remains live.
futureMechanismContract.payoffOperation: After valid consumption, request exactly one Ember through the existing bounded Ember operation, at most once in that player turn; requested and realised values remain separate telemetry.
futureMechanismContract.lifecycle: The previous-target mediator and paid flag clear at each player-turn start and combat end. Other card types and all-enemy Attacks neither consume nor replace it. A same-target Attack replaces the stored index without paying. Target death clears the stored index before another single-target Attack can consume it.
futureMechanismContract.naturalCost: Enter a multi-enemy fight, draw and pay for at least two existing single-target Attacks in one turn, keep the first target alive, then select a different living target for the next single-target Attack.
futureMechanismContract.acquisition: None. Existing current-main reward pools, rarities, cards and deck/save representation remain unchanged.
futureMechanismContract.duskBoundary: The existing Emberheart is the proposed Dusk gate. Ashwarden and mechanism-off are exact current-main paths; Emberheart's authored post-combat healing is unchanged.
futureMechanismContract.factorIsolation: Scoreline and Afterimage are separate factors fixed off. Target transfer reads only card type, authored target scope, exact selected target index, target death, current turn and exact Emberheart identity.
futureMechanismContract.rngAndPersistence: No RNG call or cursor movement, no new run-persistent field, internal ID, save version, content entry, reward entry or acquisition UI.
futureMechanismContract.telemetry: Direct research-only producer, target-survived, mediator-set/replacement/clear, consumer, same-target rejection, forced-death rejection, mediator-consume, payoff and turn-expiry stages with exact card and target indices plus requested and realised Ember.

targetSwitchPayoff.definition: Dusk-only target-transfer mediator and one-Ember payoff defined by the complete future mechanism contract.
targetSwitchPayoff.status: Only observation eligibility is evaluated here. The non-null level does not exist and may not be implemented before observation identity and actual-capacity success.

scorelinePayoff.definition: Separate closed causal factor, fixed absent and never pooled with target-switch endpoints.

afterimagePayoff.definition: Separate closed causal factor, fixed absent and never pooled with target-switch endpoints.

acquisitionPriority.definition: Frozen exact reward policy; not varied or estimated.

frozenCausalFactors.independence: Only targetSwitchPayoff could vary in a future causal experiment. Scoreline and Afterimage remain separate fixed factors. This is not the old four-factor design and no joint factorial is authorised.

current-main-trace.meaning: Identity-proved explicit-null current-main observations. Deterministic code reconstructs only an upper-bound two-single-target-Attack context.

design.type: zero-new-row source, representation, context and alias audit; not a factorial and not a causal experiment
design.construction: Enumerate every frozen observation surface and every eligible player turn in the complete 256-row rectangle. Select a surface only if exactly one passes every fixed interface gate, then apply context support, viability, card breadth, reliability and closed-family event-unit gates once.
design.contextPairRule: In a fight whose frozen starting formation has at least two enemies, filter each player turn to authored type=attack,target=enemy plays. The first two such plays form the sole upper-bound pair for that turn. Intervening Skills, Powers and all-enemy Attacks do not alter this observation interval. At most one pair per turn is counted.
design.actualSwitchRuleReservedForNextStage: After identity succeeds, a pair qualifies only when target indices differ and no DIE event for the first target occurs strictly after the first PLAY and before the second PLAY. No actual-switch count is available or estimated here.
mechanisticallyJustifiedInteractions: First PLAY target index by intervening DIE index by second PLAY target index defines deliberate switching; none alone is the mechanism.
Multi-enemy starting formation by two-single-target-Attack context is structural eligibility, not an estimated product interaction.
Dusk/Emberheart identity by target-switch payoff is the only future causal interaction; it is not estimated here.
design.aliasStructure: targetIdx-only is explicitly aliased with forced change after target death and must fail. DIE without both target indices cannot identify a switch. Exact card identities are breadth witnesses, not candidate levels. Same-target pairs, forced-death changes, all-enemy scope changes, one-card cross-target events, status transitions and named-card sequences are distinct or excluded units.
design.anchors: The frozen current-main trace is the later identity comparator. Scoreline and Afterimage policy sets are immutable overlap anchors only; their payoffs do not vary. No cross-package joint cell has decision value while both closed factors remain fixed off.
design.interferenceRule: No Scoreline or Afterimage setting may vary. If an independently admitted Dusk package later exists, shared off/off and single-package anchor cells must first measure cross-package interference before any joint target-switch cell; no Cartesian completion is permitted.
design.omittedCells: No target-specific order, exact-card subset, adjacency variant, payoff value, acquisition, rarity, policy knob, Ash intervention, RandomBuild, simulator, held-out, joint-package, ML, RL, optimiser or protected-seed cell is authorised.

observationSurfaces.interpretation: Reject: a changed index can be forced because the first target died.
Smallest sufficient surface: two existing event branches in the same trace-only harvest loop.
Reject: a new policy-loop hook and variable legal-set schema when existing events suffice.

surfaceGates.provenance: Permit only fixed scalar copies from at most two existing event branches in the already identity-proved BalanceSim harvest loop. No gameplay or policy hook is allowed.

selectionRule.rule: Exactly one surface must pass every gate and it must be the death-disambiguated existing-event surface. No fallback ranking or tie-break is allowed.

trace.selectionRule: Read the complete sole 256-row co-hand-telemetry explicit-null arm. No row, policy, seed, fight, turn, card, pair or endpoint is selected after observation.

cohort.identity: Every policy and seed from the complete identity-proved current-main rectangle is used exactly once; there is one frozen policy snapshot per identity across its four seeds.

scoreline.definition: A robust policy plays Chisel before a later Executioner in one fight in at least two of four frozen rows.
scoreline.status: Immutable overlap anchor only; Scoreline remains closed and fixed off.

afterimage.definition: A robust policy simultaneously holds Ward and Warden's Edge in at least two of four frozen rows.
afterimage.status: Immutable overlap anchor only; Afterimage remains closed and fixed off.

anchors.identity: The exact 256-row frozen trace is the future comparator after removing only targetIdx additions and the dies container.
anchors.forcedDeath: A matching DIE.idx between the two PLAY events excludes the pair rather than being relabelled as target switching.

estimands.unit: Policy identity over its complete four-seed rectangle.
estimands.activeContext: At least one upper-bound two-single-target-Attack turn in at least two of four rows.
estimands.viableContext: An active-context policy with at least one qualifying row that wins.
estimands.breadth: Distinct exact first cards, second cards and ordered pairs over all qualifying turns.
estimands.surfaceEligibility: Exactly one frozen observation surface passes all interface, sufficiency and identity-anchor gates.
estimands.reliability: Pre-existing stall/error rows in the immutable trace; no added-fault estimand exists because no simulator runs.
estimands.overlapAnchors: Candidate-context-only, anchor-only, cross-active and Jaccard policy-set overlap against separate closed Scoreline and Afterimage opportunity sets; descriptive only at this upper-bound stage.
estimands.notEstimated: Actual target identity, target survival, target-switch activation, mediator activation, Ember payoff, causal complementarity, duration effect, Ash isolation, RandomBuild/global-power movement, held-out reproducibility, package admission, detector score, product balance or protected confirmation.

contextGates.provenance: The 16-policy context, eight-policy viability and one immutable baseline-fault limits reuse the frozen 64-policy structural-capacity scale. Four cards in each position and eight exact pairs reject a named-card alias. Exact inactivity is not required before actual target indices exist because death-disambiguated switching may provide the selective inactive set.

claimBoundary: Source, trace-interface and upper-bound natural context eligibility only; no actual target-switch, mechanism, mediator, Ember payoff, causal, package-admission, detector, product or P9 claim.

decisionRules.success: Every immutable, source, trace, policy-identity, unique-surface, context-support, viability, breadth, reliability, closed-family event-unit, budget and zero-ledger check passes at the sole complete look.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Apply boundary 1: freeze only PLAY.targetIdx plus DIE.idx in the existing observation-only trace loop for one separately preregistered exact-identity experiment on the same 256 policy-seed identities. Do not add a gameplay hook, mediator, payoff, policy control, causal row, ML, RL or optimiser before that protocol is frozen.
decisionRules.futility: Any declared source, sufficiency, unique-surface, context, viability, breadth, reliability or closed-family event-unit gate fails on the complete immutable evidence.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Apply boundary 2: close the exact actual-target-switch observability direction without target-only rescue, variable legal-action snapshots, card subsets, payoff, policy, cohort or method tuning and continue with the next evidence-backed minimal structural mechanism inside #421.
decisionRules.inconclusive: An immutable input, source event, trace, schema, policy identity, ledger or wall-time check prevents the complete deterministic decision.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Apply boundary 3: record the exact missing relevant gate at the frozen cap; add no repair, rerun, replacement trace, simulator row, method or protected seed, then follow the current human-authority contract for an unavailable or inconclusive relevant gate.

order: Verify live task, current-main instructions, repository/archive refs, closed-family evidence, source, task capsule, helpers, trace and ledger identities.
Enumerate and gate the three frozen observation surfaces from current-main event sources without editing source.
Reconstruct the first upper-bound single-target Attack pair in every player turn of every frozen multi-enemy fight.
Apply support, viability, breadth, reliability and closed-family event-unit gates once.
Verify the ledger is byte-identical and apply exactly one decision boundary.
executionAndStopping.firstLook: The complete 256-row cached rectangle and three predeclared observation surfaces are the sole look. No source field, surface, predicate, threshold, cohort or endpoint may change after execution begins.
executionAndStopping.stagedConstraint: This stage can reject or justify one trace-only identity experiment. It contains no intervention or comparably evaluated enabled endpoint and cannot support a causal or package claim.
executionAndStopping.futureCrnConstraint: Any later causal contrast must freeze identical policy identities, simulation seed identities, baseline, estimator, first-look budget and stopping rule across all compared levels. Staging may move from trace evidence to whole-run evidence but may not give promising cells different cohorts.
executionAndStopping.knobIdentityConstraint: Before any gameplay mechanism row, omitted and explicit-off settings must exactly reproduce the frozen path, RNG identity and results, and direct controls must prove the knob affects only its declared target-transfer mediator.
executionAndStopping.methodConstraint: Deterministic code owns construction, caching, analysis and stop/go. No ML, RL or optimiser may be added unless this experiment first exposes a frozen policy-repertoire bottleneck and measured decision value justifies the method.
executionAndStopping.stopping: One zero-row complete-cohort look. No sequential peeking, target-only rescue, surface addition, subset selection, threshold relaxation, cohort replacement or endpoint addition.
